root_cause: Assertion-call refactors, unused arguments, cognitive complexity, and a scanner taint candidate required narrow source/test changes. Sink-local validation created a repeated literal, then GO_FTW_CONFIGURATION removed S1192 without changing behavior.
root_cause_de: Assertion-Call-Refactors, unbenutzte Argumente, kognitive Komplexität und ein Scanner-Taint-Kandidat erforderten enge Source-/Test-Änderungen. Sink-lokale Validierung erzeugte ein wiederholtes Literal, dann entfernte GO_FTW_CONFIGURATION S1192 ohne Verhaltensänderung.
proposed_remediation: Bind assertion inputs before loader calls; remove unused arguments; extract behavior-preserving helpers; retain fixed go-ftw argv, shell=False, and sink-local existing-file/directory validation; add exact-argv/negative tests; factor GO_FTW_CONFIGURATION. Do not change SonarCloud controls.
proposed_remediation_de: Assertion-Inputs vor Loader-Aufrufen binden; unbenutzte Argumente entfernen; verhaltensbewahrende Helfer extrahieren; feste go-ftw-argv, shell=False und sink-lokale Existing-File-/Directory-Validierung bewahren; Exact-argv-/Negativtests hinzufügen; GO_FTW_CONFIGURATION auslagern. SonarCloud-Kontrollen nicht ändern.

validation_plan: Retain exact-head issue, Quality Gate, check-rollup, and local-validation receipts.
Verify the authorized Squash merge, resulting main SHA, hosted main workflows, fresh main SonarCloud analysis, and legitimate control evidence before closure.
legitimate_control_tests: Metacharacter-bearing existing configuration/test paths remain individual Popen argv operands with shell=False.
Default configuration remains accepted and missing config/test paths fail before Popen.
Existing governance negative controls retain their expected errors.
residual_risk: Full go-ftw/infrastructure integration, downstream configuration semantics, and PATH trust are not claimed as resolved by this scanner remediation. The merged branch and clean task worktree are intentionally retained because the user did not authorize deletion/removal actions.
residual_risk_de: Vollständige go-ftw-/Infrastruktur-Integration, nachgelagerte Konfigurationssemantik und PATH-Trust werden nicht als durch diese Scanner-Remediation gelöst behauptet. Der gemergte Branch und das saubere Task-Worktree bleiben absichtlich erhalten, weil der Nutzer keine Lösch-/Entfernungsaktionen autorisiert hat.
evidence_limitations: Receipts prove the exact PR head, protected Squash merge, resulting main, hosted workflows, main issue count, Quality Gate, no open CodeQL alert, and focused local checks. They do not prove a full go-ftw/infrastructure integration run or resolve unrelated PATH-trust concerns.
